game.title: Assassin's Creed Odyssey
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG set in Ancient Greece during the Peloponnesian War, from Ubisoft (RAWG lists Ubisoft Montreal, Quebec, Montpellier and other studios), released 2018-10-05. RAWG average playtime: 31 hours. Genres: Action, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: A Spartan-born mercenary, Alexios or Kassandra, is caught up in the war between Athens and Sparta. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Exploring Greece and Conquest
chapters.summary: Sub-regions, underwater sites, conquest battles, region leaders, message board contracts, island quests, the arena, mercenaries and bounties.

chapters.title: The Adrestia and Naval Combat
chapters.summary: Upgrading and crewing the ship, Legendary lieutenants and sinking Epic ships.

chapters.title: Character, Abilities and Gear
chapters.summary: Levels, abilities, Legendary gear, engraving and overpower attacks.

chapters.title: Extra Named Quests
chapters.summary: Named quests and two named foes whose achievements sit outside the main game and expansion blocks; where they belong is not stated in the data.

chapters.title: Legacy of the First Blade (DLC)
chapters.summary: The Blade of the Lion, the Orders in Makedonia, Achaia and Messenia, and the Sword of Kings.

chapters.title: The Fate of Atlantis (DLC)
chapters.summary: Three episodes: Elysium, the Underworld and its Tartaros Rifts, and the Isu, with the Keeper's Insights in each.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Assassin's Creed Odyssey" or "Assassin's Creed: Odyssey". assassinscreed.fandom.com has no page under "Assassin's Creed Odyssey" but answers under "Assassin's Creed: Odyssey", with 500 or more linked pages (the link list was cut off at 500), including "Legacy of the First Blade" (with "Hunted", "Shadow Heritage" and "Bloodline") and "Elysium"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The DLC name "The Fate of Atlantis" comes from RAWG's search results. 31 of 93 Steam achievements are hidden; 6 of them sit inside the DLC blocks. Achievements were placed in the two DLC chapters by schema position and by the places and items their descriptions name (Makedonia, Achaia, Messenia and the Blade of the Lion; Elysium, Tartaros and the Keeper's Insights in Episodes 1 to 3); the split of Legacy of the First Blade into its three episodes was not made because the data does not say where each episode starts. Eight achievements ("The Show Must Go On", "Divine Intervention", "The Image of Faith", "The Daughters of Lalaia", "One Really, Really Bad Day", "Every Story Has an Ending", and defeating Steropes and Arges) sit between or just outside the DLC blocks without a region or DLC named; they were given their own chapter, which needs checking. The other 25 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter; several, such as "In Perseus's Image", "A-maze-ing Victory!", "Riddle Me This", "Master of the Hunt", "A Pirate's Life for Me" and "Going For Gold", are probably side content.
